item.text: The ingestion already maps basic WPScan fields, but its JSON struct omits Enterprise fields, and CVE references are expanded into multiple records. I’m checking the shared CVE content model to place summary, PoC, and CVSS data in fields the rest of the repository already understands.

item.text: The mapping now uses the first CVE reference only, keeps all public URLs in order, and stores optional Enterprise values in `CveContent.Optional` while leaving it as an empty map when absent. The focused Go tests are still running; I’ll report their result and inspect the final diff once they finish.

Updated WPScan ingestion in [wordpress.go](/app/detector/wordpress.go) to preserve the first canonical CVE identifier, ordered reference URLs, UTC timestamps, classification and fix version. It now maps descriptions, PoC, introduced version, and CVSS fields when present, with an empty optional map when they’re absent.

`go test ./detector ./models` was started but did not finish within the available run; I stopped it, so the tests remain unverified.
